Fee Waiver
Application Fee Waiver
*A limited number of application fee waivers are available for qualified Ph.D. applicants.*
Eligibility for a fee waiver:
Applying for the Ph.D. Program
Domestic applicant (citizen or lawful permanent resident of the United States)
Overall GPA > 3.50 (Undergraduate or Master’s Degree)
Meet program pre-requisites
Prior research experience (academia/industry/non-profit)
To apply, send these materials to BioMolecularPHD@boisestate.edu:
Please have the email subject be “FA25 Fee Waiver Application Request”.
A short statement of interest as to why you want to apply to our program (limit to 1 paragraph of 5-6 sentences)
Unofficial transcripts from undergraduate and (if applicable) graduate institutions
Curriculum Vitae (CV)
